message.text:
The mechanism is `go:embed` of the compiled `dist/` directory combined with Echo static file serving and SPA fallback. It is wired in `frontend.go` and called from `server.go`.

The mechanism is an embedded filesystem created by `go:embed` of the `dist/` directory, served via Echo static file handling with SPA fallback. It is wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` and attached to the Echo server in `server/server.go`.

The compiled React frontend is served via `go:embed` of the `dist` directory. Echo's static middleware serves the files. An SPA `index.html` fallback handles routing. This wiring lives in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`, attached from `server/server.go`.

q27.
go:embed of `dist` + Echo static middleware with SPA `index.html` fallback; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` embeds the built React assets. `FrontendService.Serve` mounts Echo `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware`. That is attached in production from `server/server.go` via `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
